Ivy L: Quick preflight for Tues event — want to lock: registration page, Zoom recording config, live captions, and post-event asset flow.
Ben K: I can own Zoom recording + SRT export. Which cloud bucket should uploads go to?
Tom R: use s3://redwood-marketing/events/2026-05-14
Ben K: perfect. I'll set auto-record to cloud and enable audio transcript.
Ivy L: also need clip highlights: 3 short clips (30-90s) + one 5-min 'highlights reel'. Can we auto-generate based on markers?
Ethan S: we can run an ffmpeg job on the recording to split by timestamps. I'll add a small job that looks for speaker cue markers.
Maya P: who will drop the in-show timestamps? Can host add quick markers in Zoom chat with format `CLIP: mm:ss - mm:ss` ?
Ivy L: yes host will do that. I'll brief them to paste markers in chat during the Q&A.
Ben K: zoom export plan:
```
- Record to cloud
- Auto-transcript enabled
- Host adds chat markers with `CLIP:` prefix
- After meeting ends, webhook triggers lambda to:
   1) download recording + transcript + chat
   2) parse `CLIP:` markers
   3) run ffmpeg to extract clips and burn captions
   4) upload clips + srt to s3 and tag metadata
```
Tom R: change for privacy — add `consent: video_optin` tag to attendee rows if they checked the box on reg page.
Ivy L: good call. Registration page must have an explicit recording consent checkbox (not pre-checked). Also add checkbox for marketing follow-up.
Ethan S: for lead routing: zapier rule -> Marketo if `marketing_optin=true` else GDrive cold-list. Add `utm_campaign` and `session_id` fields.
Maya P: post-event emails: 1) Replay w/ TL;DR (same day), 2) Clips + CTAs (48 hrs), 3) Product deep-dive (7 days). Who drafts copy?
Ivy L: Maya can draft the replay and clips emails. I'll do the 7-day follow-up.
Ben K: will also create a `manifest.json` per event with clip metadata (start, end, speaker, caption status) and include in s3.
zoom-bot: Meeting scheduled by Ivy L for 2026-05-14 11:00 PT — meeting id 987-654-321
Tom R: test run — let's schedule a dry-run 48 hrs prior to confirm marker workflow and lambda.
Ivy L: agreed. Dry-run on 2026-05-12 10:00 PT. Ben, Ethan, Tom please join and validate end-to-end.
Ethan S: I'll write the lambda and post the repo link here once ready.
Maya P: Also: add a short survey in the replay email with 2 Qs to feed into the next content iteration.
Ben K: ETA for recording pipeline: EOD Monday. Will post S3 path and IAM role details.
Ivy L: perfect. I'll update the event runbook with these responsibilities and circulate.
Maya P: thanks team :tada:
Ben K: done — created s3 bucket + role, posted in #eng-infra with IAM details.
Ethan S: lambda PR open: github.com/redwood/recording-pipeline/pull/42
Ivy L: closing checklist: registration consent ✅, zoom auto-record ✅, transcript ✅, clip markers ✅, post-email schedule ✅. We'll reconvene after dry-run.
